subject: Could you share the updated floor plan?
text:
Hey,

Hope your week isn’t too wild. Could you send over the updated floor plan when you get a chance? I’m trying to set up the community fridge corner, and I’m worried the plug outlet sits right where the bins should go. If we need to shift the walkway, I’d rather sort it out before volunteers arrive Saturday.

No rush if you’re buried, but even a rough PDF would keep me from dragging chairs around the wrong way twice. A short note about the fire exit would also help. It might save a second setup.

Warmly,
Classmate
